complexity.notes: Because the constraints guarantee lowercase English letters, each dict holds at most 26 keys, so adversarial hash collisions cannot degrade lookups beyond a constant factor and space is O(1). Non-idiomatic: a bare except is poor style, and collections.Counter(s) == collections.Counter(t) would express this in one line; the second comparison loop is only needed to catch keys present in t but absent in s.
complexity.summary: Builds frequency-count dictionaries for both strings, then compares counts for every key in each dictionary (using a bare try/except to treat missing keys as mismatches).
